values.note: 2026 season: standard primitive (open) sites $30, electric 30/50-amp sites $50, group sites from $80, tipi $80; day use $5. Rates assume 2 adults, 2 children, 2 pets and 1 vehicle; extra adults or children $5, pets $3, vehicles $10, horses $5 a day. Payment in full at reservation; full payment non-refundable inside 14 days. The page gives no site lengths for the primitive sites.

values.note: 6 electric sites and 86 primitive campsites, plus group sites and traditional lodges (tipis).

sites.source: https://blackfeetcampgrounds.com/accommodation/red-eagle/ ('6 electrical sites and 86 primitive campsites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Porta-potties; no water at the sites. Lake for swimming, kayaks and paddle boards (no motorized craft); fishing with a tribal permit.

facilities.source: https://blackfeetcampgrounds.com/accommodation/red-eagle/ (Amenities: 'Porta Potties', 'Wifi', 'Kayaking/ Paddle Boards No motorized watercraft allowed'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online through the Blackfeet Tribal Campgrounds' page on campgroundreservations.com (Good Sam's reservation system): 'available for online reservations: from January 4 at 10:00 AM MDT to September 30 at 08:00 PM MDT'. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon; gate closed 10 p.m.-6 a.m. (walk-in access only). The campground closes to the public for the Glacier Half Marathon in late June (6/25-6/28 in 2026).

booking.source: https://blackfeetcampgrounds.com/accommodation/red-eagle/ ('Book Online', check-in/out, quiet-hours gate, half-marathon closure) + https://reserve.campgroundreservations.com/search_sites?gs_campground_id=202021705, read 2026-10-22

note: Blackfeet Nation tribal campground on the Two Medicine Road near East Glacier Park, 3.4 mi from Glacier's Two Medicine entrance; swimming and paddling on the lake, tribal fishing permit required; horses allowed if hitched. --Claude
summary: Tribal campground page (2026 season): confirmed $50 electric (30/50-amp) and $30 primitive; added no water at sites, 92 sites (6 electric + 86 primitive), Wi-Fi, online booking via campgroundreservations.com (Jan 4 - Sep 30 booking period). Note corrected: it no longer books on ResNexus; price and RV Life lines dropped. Not stated: season dates, site lengths, whether primitive sites take a 23-ft rig (base recorded as $30 with that caveat).
flags: Phone: the campground page gives (406) 338-2111 ext. 2161 (booking page +1 406 338 2111); the entry has 844-335-5178.
